solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Impartial peacekeepers stationed around Indonesia's capital

parts.note: UN peacekeepers are the United Nations forces

indicators.note: the word for stationed goes round the letter taken from Indonesia

parts.note: troops stationed somewhere are based there

indicators.note: a capital letter is the first one, here of the country's name

explanation.surface: Neutral blue-helmeted troops are posted around Jakarta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like Jakarta, but it is the first letter, I, which goes inside BASED.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone who favours neither side; a straight synonym.

clue.text: Not straightforward when short of assistance

parts.note: under can mean less than or short of
a hand is help or assistance

explanation.surface: Someone acts deviously when lacking help.
explanation.definitionFit: Underhand dealing is sly and secretive rather than open.

clue.text: Protective covering for the ears forbidden over time

indicators.note: in a down clue over puts the first piece above the second
for the ears means the word is taken as it is heard

parts.note: banned means forbidden
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Earmuffs are banned for a while.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandage is a strip of material wrapped round a wound to protect it.

clue.text: Leaderless splinter group gets something done

indicators.note: leaderless means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: a faction is a breakaway group within a larger body

explanation.surface: A rebel group with no head still gets results.
explanation.definitionFit: An action is a deed, a thing that has been done.

clue.text: Former partner to criticise strongly after joke becomes clear

indicators.note: after places the criticism word following the joke

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
a good one is a joke, as in 'that's a good one'
to rate someone is to scold them severely

explanation.surface: An ex lays into a joke until it is cleared up.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate someone is to declare them free of blame.

clue.text: Die from lemonade gone bad

parts.note: pop is fizzy soft drink such as lemonade
food that has gone bad is off

explanation.surface: Someone is killed by drinking spoiled lemonade.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop off is informal slang for dying suddenly.

clue.text: Scoff largely at nonsense in support of Portugal's winger

indicators.note: in a down clue the later pieces sit beneath and support the first

parts.note: P is the international vehicle code for Portugal

indicators.note: largely means most of the word, losing the last letter

parts.note: to scoff food is to eat it greedily
cock is old slang for nonsense, as in poppycock

explanation.surface: Mocking nonsense backs up Portugal's wide player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' looks like a footballer, Portugal's wide man, but means a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird is a creature with wings, and this showy one is a cryptic example.

clue.text: Inclined to include note on books catching the eye

indicators.note: in a down clue on puts the first part above the books
to include means the note is placed inside

parts.note: prone means inclined or liable
mi is a note of the sol-fa scale
NT is the New Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A tendency to put notes on books grabs attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prominent stands out and is readily noticed.

clue.text: Large cask blocking the front part by chance

indicators.note: blocking means the cask sits inside, blocking the other word

parts.note: the fore is the front part of something
a tun is a large barrel for wine or beer

explanation.surface: A big barrel happens to block the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Fortune means luck or chance as a force in events.

clue.text: Not entirely prepared to be a Mafia boss

indicators.note: not entirely means the synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: a meal that is prepared is done

explanation.surface: Someone is not quite ready to head a crime family.
explanation.definitionFit: A don is the head of a Mafia family, as in the Godfather films.

clue.text: Uncertain about having rector next to sullen love poet

indicators.note: next to places one piece directly after the other
the jumbled letters have the abbreviation for rector placed inside them
uncertain suggests the letters of about are unsettled and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
dour means sullen or gloomy

explanation.surface: A doubtful clergyman sits beside a gloomy writer of love verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uncertain' makes TOUBA, and 'having' puts the rector's letter inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Troubadours were medieval Provençal poets who sang of courtly love.

clue.text: Set forth logically in study about working in the London area

indicators.note: about means the study word surrounds the rest

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university

indicators.note: in places the word for working inside the postal area letters

parts.note: SE is the south-east London postal district
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: Someone argued a case carefully in a study about jobs in London.
explanation.walkthrough: The inner nesting gives SONE, which the study word wraps; the first 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A reasoned argument is one laid out through logical thought.

clue.text: Very unpleasant when cramped? Not half

indicators.note: not half removes the first half of the twelve-letter synonym

parts.note: incommodious means uncomfortably small or cramped

explanation.surface: A cramped space is described as unpleasant, with a slangy 'not half!' for emphasis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half' reads as British slang for 'very much so', but it trims the first six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Odious means hateful or highly offensive, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Speaks with passion dismissing earliest of revolutionary periods

indicators.note: dismissing means a letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: someone who rages speaks angrily and passionately

indicators.note: earliest of takes the first letter of revolutionary

explanation.surface: A firebrand rants about the opening of revolutionary eras.
explanation.definitionFit: Ages are long eras or periods of history.

clue.text: Things worn by a baseball infielder

definitions.meaning: short trousers and an upper garment, two items of clothing read as a pair
the fielder stationed between second and third base

explanation.walkthrough: Split as SHORTS and TOP, the answer is clothing; whole, it is a baseball position.
explanation.definitionFit: The fielder between second and third base in baseball is called this.

clue.text: A bit of fun at last leading to hesitation by Mellors perhaps

indicators.note: leading to puts the earlier pieces before the hesitation sound

parts.note: a game is a bit of fun
food that will last will keep
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Fun at last leads to hesitation for Lawrence's famous lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' tempts as a final-letter signal; here last is a verb meaning endure.
explanation.definitionFit: Mellors is the estate's game warden in D. H. Lawrence's Lady Chatterley's Lover, hence an example.

clue.text: Appallingly inelegant of Rose

indicators.note: appallingly suggests the letters are treated badly and scrambled

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone called Rose is criticised as dreadfully clumsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rose' poses as a woman's name, or a past tense; it is the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Eglantine is the sweet briar, a wild species of the flower.

clue.text: Ranted about keeping horse when no longer needed

indicators.note: keeping means the scrambled letters hold the horse inside
about indicates the letters of ranted are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
a dun is a greyish-brown horse

explanation.surface: Someone ranted about having to keep a horse that is surplus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives REDANT, which 'keeping' splits after RE to hold the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Redundant means surplus to requirements, as with laid-off workers.

clue.text: Irregular soldier shot crossing road near the centre of Okayama

indicators.note: near places the final letter right after the rest
the scrambled letters cross over the road abbreviation, holding it inside
shot means wrecked, so the letters of soldier are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

indicators.note: the centre of a seven-letter word is its fourth letter

explanation.surface: A soldier is shot crossing a road in a Japanese city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' gives DISOERL, which 'crossing' opens to hold the road; 'near' adds the middle of Okayama.
explanation.definitionFit: Disorderly means untidy or lacking regular order.

clue.text: Starts to investigate several options towards the end of quarantine

indicators.note: starts to takes the first letters of the next three words

parts.note: late means near the end of a period

explanation.surface: Investigators look at options as quarantine draws to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarantine someone is to keep them apart, or set them apart.

clue.text: Hopelessness of father exhibited in want for the most part

indicators.note: exhibited in places the father word inside the other
for the most part means all but the last letter

parts.note: desire means want
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A father's despondency shows in his longing.
explanation.definitionFit: Despair is the complete loss of hope.

clue.text: Minister to become widely spoken about on social media site right away

indicators.note: away means the letter for right is sent off

parts.words: become widely spoken about on social media site
parts.note: a topic that trends is widely discussed on a site such as X

explanation.surface: A clergyman becomes the talk of social media at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister' looks like a noun, a vicar; it is the verb 'minister to'. 'right away' reads as 'at once' but drops R.
explanation.definitionFit: To minister to someone is to care for and look after them.

clue.text: A refusal to receive Labour leader is sent back by letter

indicators.note: sent back means the whole is read in reverse
to receive means the refusal takes the pieces inside

parts.note: nope is a casual refusal

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of Labour

explanation.surface: A snub to the Labour leader is returned by post.
explanation.walkthrough: NOPE takes in L and IS to make NOLISPE, which 'sent back' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Bring to light deception of leave campaigner at last

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of campaigner
deception suggests the letters of leave are disguised by rearrangement

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: The lies of a Brexit Leave campaigner are finally exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leave campaigner' reads as a Brexiteer, but 'leave' is anagrammed to EVEAL and R, from 'campaigner', goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal something is to uncover it or make it known.

clue.text: My place is back in the Spanish legislature

parts.note: cor is an exclamation of surprise, like my!

indicators.note: back means the word for place is read in reverse

parts.note: to place something is to set it down

explanation.surface: A Spanish politician claims a seat back in parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cortes is the name of Spain's parliament.

clue.text: Wearing for each boy actually present

parts.note: someone dressed in a coat is wearing it
per means for each
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Clothing for each boy who turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: Being there in person means attending physically rather than remotely.

clue.text: Right to have volunteers around getting involved and arousing interest

indicators.note: around means the joined pair is turned back to front

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force
someone actively involved is active

explanation.surface: A right-winger has volunteers around getting involved, stirring interest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' turns RTTA into ATTR. The TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Something attractive draws people in and holds their interest.

clue.text: Field ambulance eventually obtained by the French

indicators.note: obtained by means the letter is held inside the French article

parts.note: la is a French word for the

indicators.note: eventually picks out the final letter of ambulance

explanation.surface: A battlefield ambulance unit finally reaches French hands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Field ambulance' reads as a military medical unit; the definition is 'Field' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Lea is a poetic word for a meadow or grassy field.

clue.text: Style of painting ultimately lacking self-control

indicators.note: ultimately lacking means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: tempera is painting with egg-based pigments

explanation.surface: An artist's style is finally criticised as lacking self-control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking self-control' wants to be read together; 'lacking' belongs with 'ultimately'.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep one's temper is to keep composure, so the word can mean calm restraint.

clue.text: Firm's comfortable sports clothing worn by Neymar primarily

parts.note: comfortably off means well off

indicators.note: worn by places the letter from Neymar within the clothing word

parts.note: kit is a team's sports clothing

indicators.note: primarily takes the first letter of Neymar

explanation.surface: A company's comfy sportswear is worn by the Brazilian footballer.
explanation.walkthrough: Neymar is a Brazilian footballer; only his first letter, N, is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Something well-knit is solidly and tightly put together, hence firm.
